payload.instruction: Joint screen/speech grounding. Read actual PNGs, full transcript, original event coordinates/time and prior accepted binding. The overlaid cross/path and event IDs visualize raw observations; they are NOT inferred targets. Original coordinates are frame pixels with supplied width/height. Identify exact visible item/sample IDs for each expression. For corrections preserve the explicitly retained binding, revise replaced bindings, recheck the complete set. Historic pointing remains on its original frame after navigation. A loop may designate plotted samples. You own both target extents and final binding. Do not perform the business task. Return ONLY compact JSON: {intent:string,adoptions:[{expression_id:string,targets:[visible_id],status:'ready'|'ambiguous'|'need_evidence',count:integer|null,relation:'point_inside'|'within_region'|'relative_position'|'retain_prior'|'other',cue_ids:[event_id],extents:[{target_id,frame_id,label:visible_header_max60chars,bbox:[x1,y1,x2,y2]}],evidence:string}],need_evidence:false|{scope:string}}. Each expression once, count is the number required by speech when explicit; IDs must be visible, bbox in original frame pixels and within frame bounds. A point-inside coordinate must fall in chosen bbox. For loop sample sets, each sample bbox center must be in the raw polygon. Request source reread or mark unresolved on contradiction. Evidence max100 characters, intent max120 characters; no chain-of-thought or extra reasoning fields. Any auxiliary parser data is fallible derived interpretation, never truth; verify original pixels/events.
